Name: NoFlowerHarvest
Author: Saodm262
Description:
[size=4][b]No Flower Harvest (禁止采花 / 花の収穫禁止)
[/b][/size]
[heading][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/heading]
[size=4][b]Tired of accidentally picking the flowers you carefully planted — a stray right-click, one scythe swing, or a junimo that grabs everything in sight? No Flower Harvest stops you from harvesting the flowers you planted yourself, so they stay in the ground to keep decorating your farm and feeding your bee houses all season long.
The mod blocks the harvesting of every plantable flower crop: Blue Jazz, Tulip, Poppy, Summer Spangle, Fairy Rose and Sunflower in the vanilla game, plus any new flower crops added by expansion mods such as Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village — automatically, with no manual configuration. The flower crop is never destroyed; it simply stays planted.
New in 1.4.0 — bee-house aware mode. If you would rather pick your flowers everywhere [i]except[/i] where they are actually doing work, enable "Only block flowers near bee houses". The mod then blocks only the fully grown flowers sitting inside a bee house's own flower range — the same 5-tile range and the same flower rules the game itself uses to decide which flower flavours the honey — and every other flower becomes harvestable again. It is off by default and sits right below the "Allow harvesting ALL flowers" option.
It can also optionally block outdoor flower forage — Daffodil, Dandelion, Sweet Pea and Crocus, plus flower forage from expansion mods (e.g. SVE's Thistle or Goldenrod). Forage blocking is off by default and can be enabled per item or all at once.
[/b][/size]

[/list][heading][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Blocks every harvest method — right-click harvest, scythe harvest, junimo harvesters and modded tools (e.g. Tractor Mod) are all intercepted. The flower crop is never destroyed; it simply stays planted.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Bee-house aware mode (new in 1.4.0) — optionally protect only the flowers your bee houses depend on. A flower is protected when it is fully grown and within 5 tiles of a bee house, using the game's own bee-house flower search, so the protection matches exactly what the game considers "the flowers feeding this hive". Every other flower can be harvested normally; flowers you explicitly ticked as [i]allowed[/i] stay harvestable even next to a hive. Only planted flowers are affected — forage is untouched.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Expansion-mod friendly — flowers are detected using the same logic the game itself uses for bee-house honey (the harvest item's "Flower" category), so any mod that adds plantable flower crops — Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and others — is picked up automatically. No hardcoded lists to maintain.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Per-flower control — the config menu lists every discovered flower with its own toggle. By default every flower is blocked; tick the ones you want to allow.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Optional forage-flower blocking — outdoor flower forage can be blocked per item or all at once via a master toggle (allowed by default, matching vanilla behaviour).[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smart defaults — newly discovered flowers are added to the list automatically and blocked by default, so new content can never sneak past the rule.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Clear feedback — when a harvest is blocked, a red message tells you why (throttled so it never spams the screen). Flowers blocked because they are feeding a bee house get their own message.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Full control — master switch, "allow everything" override, the new "only near bee houses" toggle, a separate junimo toggle, and the 
[/b][/size]
[code]noflower_list[/code][size=4][b] / 
[/b][/size]
[code]noflower_refresh[/code][size=4][b] console commands.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Fully localized — all menus, messages and even the mod's name and hover description follow your game language: English, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Русский, Italiano (new 1.4.0 strings are translated to English and 中文; other languages fall back to English). Flower names use the game's own localized names.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=4][b]What's new in 1.4.0[/b][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Added the "Only block flowers near bee houses" option (off by default), placed directly below "Allow harvesting ALL flowers".[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Uses the game's own bee-house logic to decide what counts as a flower near a hive: fully grown, not dead, within the vanilla 5-tile bee-house search range.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Added a dedicated red message for flowers that are flavouring a nearby bee house.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][code]noflower_list[/code][size=4][b] now also reports the new option's state.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]The mod's version is now consistent between 
[/b][/size]
[code]manifest.json[/code][size=4][b] and the assembly (both 1.4.0).[/b][/size][/*]

Manifest.Name: No Flower Harvest
Manifest.Description: Prevents harvesting flowers you planted (Blue Jazz, Tulip, Poppy, Summer Spangle, Fairy Rose, Sunflower, plus flower crops from expansion mods like SVE / Ridgeside Village), so they stay for honey and decoration. Right-click, scythe, junimo and tractor harvesting are all blocked without destroying the crop. Optionally only block the flowers near bee houses (new in 1.4.0, off by default), or also block outdoor flower forage. All UI text follows your game language.
